title: AEGIS: Anchor-Enforced Gradient Isolation for Knowledge-Preserving Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2604.16067v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for robotic manipulation introduces a fundamental stability-plasticity dilemma: continuous flow-matching action experts backpropagate concentrated, low-rank regression gradients into transformer backbones trained on high-dimensional cross-entropy objectives. This cross-modal gradient asymmetry rapidly degrades pre-trained visual reasoning. Existing solutions either disconnect continuous gradient flow via stop-gradients or constrain updates via LoRA, which restricts update rank but remains directionally blind to semantic corruption; both typically rely on mixed-batch VQA co-training, doubling training compute. We introduce AEGIS (Anchor-Enforced Gradient Isolation System), a buffer-free, layer-wise orthogonal gradient projection framework enabling continuous flow-matching fine-tuning while isolating pre-trained representations from destructive parameter updates. translated_title: AEGIS：面向知识保持的视觉-语言-动作微调的锚定强制梯度隔离方法
translated_abstract: 为机器人操作任务微调预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）会引入一个根本性的稳定性-可塑性困境：连续流匹配动作专家会将集中的、低秩的回归梯度反向传播到基于高维交叉熵目标训练的Transformer主干网络中。这种跨模态梯度不对称性会迅速损害预训练的视觉推理能力。现有解决方案要么通过停止梯度来断开连续梯度流，要么通过LoRA来约束更新——后者虽然限制了更新的秩，但对语义破坏在方向上仍是盲目的；此外，这两种方法通常都依赖混合批次的VQA联合训练，使训练计算量翻倍。我们提出AEGIS（锚定强制梯度隔离系统），这是一个无缓冲区、逐层正交梯度投影框架，能够在支持连续流匹配微调的同时，将预训练表示与破坏性参数更新隔离开来。在训练之前，……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: AEGIS提出了一种无缓冲区、逐层正交梯度投影的锚定强制梯度隔离框架，在连续流匹配微调视觉-语言-动作模型时有效保护预训练的视觉推理能力，避免破坏性参数更新带来的语义损伤。
en_tdlr: AEGIS introduces a buffer-free, layer-wise orthogonal gradient projection framework that enables continuous flow-matching fine-tuning of vision-language-action models while isolating pre-trained representations from destructive parameter updates, preserving visual reasoning capabilities.
